summary: Verified TipJarMaster (Master) engine + red header button + Master sub-tabs (Slips/Live) + live de-rating (danger badge) + Experts showcase flame gating. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass on public URL. Frontend: Master button is FIRST in header (red rgb(225,29,42)), Master tab (data-testid=tabview-master) opens, both Slips + Live sub-tabs render seeded tips with red card + master-badge (crown, no Experte badge). Live tab shows 3 'AT RISK' danger badges (data-testid=tip-live-danger) with 3-star rating. Our Experts showcase shows bold 20px/900 names, no flame emoji anywhere in showcase or expert-banner, and TipJarMaster is correctly excluded from experts list. One minor backend inconsistency observed on the SEED-QA-DANGER tip: live_danger stays True and ai_rating stays 3.0, but category field oscillates between 'risk' and 'banker' between polls — UI shows 'AT RISK' badge (correct, driven by live_danger flag) but the category chip may render 'BANKER' instead of 'RISK'.

minor.issue: category field oscillates: initial call returned category='risk'; subsequent call returned category='banker' while live_danger stayed True, category_orig='banker', ai_rating=3.0, ai_rating_orig=9.0. Something (likely live_annotate_sync path when the fake fixture is not in API-Football live list) reverts category without also clearing live_danger. UI badge (data-testid=tip-live-danger 'AT RISK') still works because it's flag-driven, but the category chip may still say BANKER instead of RISK — contradicting the requirement 'category shown as RISK (not BANKER)'.

action_items: Investigate why category reverts from 'risk' back to 'banker' on SEED-QA-DANGER while live_danger remains True. Possibly in live_annotate_sync or an alternative live-refresh path that resets category from an origin field without going through _derate_fields. Ensure category stays 'risk' as long as live_danger is True, or make the UI category chip render from live_danger (show 'RISK' if live_danger else category).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _derate_fields only sets category='risk' on the danger transition (if not t.get('live_danger')). If another process later clears/rewrites category without going through _derate_fields (or without also flipping live_danger), state becomes inconsistent. Consider making the API response derive an effective category on read (e.g. return 'risk' whenever live_danger=True) so UI is always consistent regardless of write-path race.

If main agent applies the effective-category fix, retest by hitting /api/tips?status=live and confirming SEED-QA-DANGER returns category='risk' whenever live_danger=true.
rca of the issue: SEED-QA-DANGER's category flipped back to 'banker' after being set to 'risk'. Root cause hypothesis: live_annotate_sync (server.py:6871) iterates live tips and calls _derate_fields only when it locates the tip's fixture in the live API-Football feed. The seeded 'Epsilon FC vs Zeta SC' fixture is fake — not in the feed — so no explicit danger evaluation happens, but some other refresh path is resetting `category` from `category_orig` or the original tip document without going through _derate_fields (or without also flipping live_danger). live_danger remains True so the UI 'AT RISK' badge still renders, but the category chip shows BANKER. Mitigation: (1) in _derate_fields, always re-assert category='risk' whenever live_danger stays True; or (2) derive category on API read: `if t['live_danger']: t['category']='risk'` in list_tips serialization. Option (2) is safest.
